mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَارٌّ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَارٌّ is read haarr and means hot.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نَ?
mcq.explanation: نَ is read na.

mcq.q: The sentence ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub says where a cup is. Where is it?
mcq.explanation: ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub means 'on the table there is a cup'.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word تَحْتَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: تَحْتَ is read taHta and means under.

mcq.q: What does the little word li- mean in li-Aminata?
mcq.explanation: li- means 'for', so li-Aminata is 'for Amina'.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ب?
mcq.explanation: The letter ب is called baa.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "family"?
mcq.explanation: أُسْرَةٌ (usra) means family.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter خ make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter خ makes the sound kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أُخْتٌ (ukht) mean?
mcq.explanation: أُخْتٌ (ukht) means sister.

mcq.q: How do you say 'on Monday'?
mcq.explanation: yawma l-ithnayn means 'on the day of Monday'.

mcq.q: What does jism mean?
mcq.explanation: jism means body.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بِنْتٌ (bint) mean?
mcq.explanation: بِنْتٌ (bint) means daughter.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word رَأْسٌ (raʾs) mean?
mcq.explanation: رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "festival"?
mcq.explanation: عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ (haadhihi shams) means: This is the sun.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ الْيَوْمَ؟ mean?
mcq.explanation: كَيْفَ الْجَوُّ الْيَوْمَ؟ (kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?) means: How is the weather today?

mcq.q: What is meant by listening for the gist?
mcq.explanation: The gist is the main idea. You do not need to understand every word.

mcq.q: Why are special occasions important for a community?
options: They bring people together and help them to live in peace
They are only for the rich
mcq.explanation: Celebrations bring families and friends together and build unity.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "birthday"?
mcq.explanation: عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ (ʿiid miilaad) means birthday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "stand up"?
mcq.explanation: قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً mean?
mcq.explanation: أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً (azraʿu shajara) means: I plant a tree.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "finger"?
mcq.explanation: إِصْبَعٌ (isbaʿ) means finger.

mcq.q: What sits on the baseline in Arabic writing?
mcq.explanation: Most letters rest on the baseline. Alif stands tall above it.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نِ?
mcq.explanation: نِ is read ni.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word ذُرَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: ذُرَةٌ is read dhura and means maize.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ (ashrabu sh-shaaya) means: I drink tea.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي (ashummu bi-anfii) means: I smell with my nose.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ mean?
options: I visit my grandmother on Friday.
I help my mother on Saturday.
I read a book on Sunday.
mcq.explanation: أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ mean?
options: And the rain is from the sky.
The sun is in the sky.
mcq.explanation: الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ (ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i) means: The sun is in the sky.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "read"?
mcq.explanation: اِقْرَأْ (iqraʾ) means read.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ (as-samaku ladhiidh) means: The fish is delicious.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I like bananas."
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My sister reads."
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Do you have a party? (to a boy)"
mcq.explanation: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ (hal ʿindaka hafla?) means: Do you have a party? (to a boy)

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مُ?
mcq.explanation: مُ is read mu.

mcq.q: Why do people use pictures to communicate?
options: Pictures can be understood by people who speak different languages
mcq.explanation: A picture can carry a message without words.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word فَوْقَ (fawqa) mean?
mcq.explanation: فَوْقَ (fawqa) means above.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَالُونٌ (baaluun) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَالُونٌ (baaluun) means balloon.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable سِ?
mcq.explanation: سِ is read si.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: بِيئَةٌ is read bii'a and means environment.

mcq.q: Which line of the poem means 'My nose smells'?
mcq.explanation: anf is nose and yashummu means smells.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "plate"?
mcq.explanation: صَحْنٌ (sahn) means plate.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word كَتِفٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: كَتِفٌ is read katif and means shoulder.

mcq.q: What does the word mufiid mean?
mcq.explanation: mufiid means useful or good for you.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) means school.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
On the table there is a cup.
What is your name? (to a girl)
mcq.explanation: فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ (fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii) means: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَمَامَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَمَامَ is read amaama and means in front of.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَا اسْمُكَ؟ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ is read maa ismuka? and means What is your name? (to a boy).

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word صَحْنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: صَحْنٌ is read sahn and means plate.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word اِسْمَعْ (ismaʿ) mean?
mcq.explanation: اِسْمَعْ (ismaʿ) means listen.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مِلْعَقَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مِلْعَقَةٌ is read milʿaqa and means spoon.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "father's brother"?
mcq.explanation: عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) mean?
mcq.explanation: عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) means eye.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "vegetables"?
mcq.explanation: خُضَارٌ (khudaar) means vegetables.

mcq.q: What is a stanza?
options: A group of lines in a poem
mcq.explanation: A stanza is like a paragraph in a poem.

mcq.q: What does the word يَا (yaa) do in مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ?
options: It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
mcq.explanation: yaa is used to call someone by name.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ز make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ز makes the sound z as in zebra.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word تَحْتَ (taHta) mean?
mcq.explanation: تَحْتَ (taHta) means under.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَخٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَخٌ is read akh and means brother.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "leg"?
mcq.explanation: رِجْلٌ (rijl) means leg.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ظ?
mcq.explanation: The letter ظ is called DHaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ (al-jawwu haarr) means: The weather is hot.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) means welcome.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word يَدٌ (yad) mean?
mcq.explanation: يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

mcq.q: Which is a rule of good turn taking?
options: Speak at the same time as others
Wait until the speaker has finished
mcq.explanation: Good speakers wait for their turn and use polite words if they must interrupt.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter س?
mcq.explanation: The letter س is called siin.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word رِجْلٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: رِجْلٌ is read rijl and means leg.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Do you like bananas?"
mcq.explanation: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word لَحْمٌ (lahm) mean?
mcq.explanation: لَحْمٌ (lahm) means meat.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "cold"?
mcq.explanation: بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.
